app.demoNotice: GIK credits are demo credits only. They have no cash value.

welcome.headline: GIKGOK
welcome.body: A private, mobile-first game platform using GIK demo credits. No real-money deposits, cash-out, or wallets — ever.
welcome.deleted: Account deletion requested. Ledger and audit records are preserved.

auth.verifyBody: Enter the OTP sent to your contact. At least one verified contact is required before playing.

home.verifyHint: Verify your contact to unlock play and welcome credit.

guide.title: Game Guide
guide.body: Browse without signing in. Playing requires a verified account. GIK credits are demo credits only and have no cash value.
guide.fpc: Fish–Prawn–Crab — symbol dice with Single Symbol and Special Pair bets
guide.highlow: High–Low Dice — predict high or low; triples lose both sides
guide.plate: Spinning Plate — pick one of twelve slots and land exactly
guide.fpcBody: Three dice show Fish, Prawn, Crab, Gourd, Rooster, or Deer. Single Symbol: pick one — if it appears on any die, Total Return is x2. Special Pair: pick two different symbols — both must appear for Total Return x10. Outcomes are settled on the server; visuals only reveal the result.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.body: Secure admin routing, permissions, and operational modules continue in later phases. This shell reserves the /admin boundary.

fpc.name: Fish–Prawn–Crab
fpc.tagline: Pick a symbol or special pair. Server settles Total Return — visuals only reveal.

kind.singleHelp: Choose exactly one symbol. At least one matching die wins Total Return x2.
kind.pairHelp: Choose two different symbols. Both must appear across the three dice for Total Return x10.

error.pairDistinct: Special Pair needs two different symbols.
error.unexpected: Settlement response was incomplete. Try Resume if a pending key exists.
